text: Flutterwave's $250 million Series D round, reported by TechCrunch in February 2022, was led by B Capital Group with participating investors Alta Park Capital, Whale Rock Capital and Lux Capital; existing investors Avenir Growth, Tiger Global, Glynn Capital, Green Visor and Salesforce Ventures also invested. No state or state fund is among the named investors.
short: Flutterwave's named investors are venture capital firms; no state fund is named.

source.name: TechCrunch: African fintech Flutterwave triples valuation to over $3B after $250M Series D
source.quote: backers in this Series D round include lead investor B Capital Group and participating investors Alta Park Capital, Whale Rock Capital, and Lux Capital
source.note: Same sentence continues: 'Existing investors such as Avenir Growth, Tiger Global, Glynn Capital, Green Visor and Salesforce Ventures also doubled down.'
